answer: Each epoch the network plants fake identities among real ones and assigns every agent a different suspect to investigate. Like light through a prism, one probe splits into many checks — behavior, funding, timing — and only a genuine investigator catches the planted clone. An umber trail of contradictions marks the fake, while honest work gathers at a shared oasis of verified agents. A farm steering a thousand clones must investigate a thousand distinct suspects, and clones that vouch for each other get caught by the planted fakes among them, so detection labor grows faster than clone count.
